muscle_regions.name: Quadriceps femoris region
muscle_regions.mask: Anterior thigh, 13–91% of hip-to-knee bone length; smooth angular and longitudinal falloffs.

muscle_regions.name: Adductor magnus-centered posteromedial region
muscle_regions.role: Primary hip-extension contribution in the wide stance
muscle_regions.mask: Focused proximal posteromedial thigh, 7–70% of hip-to-knee length; does not label the whole medial thigh as one exact muscle.

muscle_regions.name: Gluteus maximus region
muscle_regions.mask: Posterior hip skin in rest z 0.82–0.98 m; normally occluded by the opaque black shorts.

muscle_regions.name: Hamstring region
muscle_regions.mask: Posterior thigh, 18–87% of hip-to-knee length, excluding primary-region overlap.

muscle_regions.name: Lumbar erector spinae regions
muscle_regions.mask: Paired posterior lumbar strips, rest z 1.02–1.27 m and lateral x 0.018–0.075 m.

interpretation: Qualitative movement-role regions. The mesh retains its fibre detail and lighting. Anatomical surface masks are smoothly blended to fit the existing skinned model.
